summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in its own shares on 9 July 2026. It purchased 7,000,000 ordinary shares via Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 112.108 pence, with prices ranging from 111.600 to 112.500 pence. This buyback is part of an existing programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. The filing is a routine repurchase update, not a special situation; it does not alter control or represent a structural event. No further action or unusual terms are noted.
